parsed.summary: Tracing every sheet against the specification, the schematic reproduces the intended design: the ESP32-C3 GPIO map (SCK=GPIO5, SO=GPIO10, CS0/1/2=GPIO4/6/7, HEATER=GPIO1, LED=GPIO0), the TPS2121RUXR power mux (IN1=+12V, IN2=+5V, OUT=VBUS, ILIM via R12=51.1k, SS via C5=10nF, OV/PR/CP/ST/GND to GND), the AP63203WU fixed 3.3V buck (FB tied to +3V3, L1=3.9uH, C13=100nF bootstrap), the TPS1H200 high-side switch (VS=+12V, IN/DIAG_EN=HEATER, CL/GND/EP to GND, OUT to J6, FAULT to TP6), the three MAX31855 channels on the shared SCK/SO bus with independent CS0/CS1/CS2, and the USB-C CC pulldowns and WS2812B all match the netlist-derived values. The only oddities are properties the spec already documents as known limitations (D7 being a plain diode on the 12V rail, the unmonitored FAULT pin, the placeholder LED/strapping choices) or benign drawing conventions, so no behavior-changing deviation is supported by the drawing.
